in_hebrew.name: חומובץ'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Homovec in Hebrew means 'graceful strength'. It is derived from the Hebrew roots 'chomah' meaning 'strength' and 'ovech' meaning 'grace'.

in_greek.name: Χομοβηκός
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Homovec in Greek means 'strong in grace'. It is derived from the Greek roots 'choma' meaning 'strength' and 'vic' meaning 'grace'.

in_latin.name: Gratitudinarius
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Homovec in Latin means 'bearer of grace'. It is derived from the Latin roots 'gratia' meaning 'grace' and 'dare' meaning 'to bear'.
